2610.12738.title: KITE: A Knowledge-Injected Temporal Encoder for Time-Series Event Forecasting
2610.12738.paper_summary: Forecasting rare, high-cost events in multivariate time-series systems is hard because their precursors are seldom observed, so a purely data-driven model has little to learn from. The engineers who run these systems, however, hold knowledge that precedes such events, information absent from the scarce labels. We call this a semantic prior and inject it into a self-supervised event forecaster through two switchable mechanisms, a covariate mechanism and an attention-bias mechanism, each the identity at its null, so one architecture serves every prior type with no per-dataset architecture search. A prior helps when it supplies information the observed window does not already contain: in a short context an informative prior beats no prior in-domain (pooled h-AUROC over the no-prior baseline: a periodicity clock +14%, p<0.001; a conservation residual +47% at a 0.25 label fraction), and a working prior transfers out-of-domain (+53%), substituting for feature transfer, while priors the window already recovers stay inert and the attention-bias mechanism shows no measurable gain. KITE is a switchable, attributable route to contextual conditioning, and a substrate for scaling toward cross-domain, pretrained time-series foundation world models that carry their governing structure explicitly.
2610.12738.paper_summary_zh: 預測多變量時間序列系統中的稀有高成本事件是困難的，因為它們的前兆很少被觀察到，因此純粹的數據驅動模型幾乎無法學到任何東西。然而，運行這些系統的工程師擁有先於這些事件的知識，這些信息在稀少的標籤中是缺失的。我們稱這為語義先驗，並通過兩種可切換機制將其注入自我監督的事件預測器中，一種是協變量機制，另一種是注意力偏差機制，每種機制在其空值時都是恒等，因此一個架構可以服務於每種類型的先驗，而無需針對每個數據集進行架構搜索。當先驗提供的信息是觀察窗口中尚未包含的時候，它能夠發揮作用：在短上下文中，一個有用的先驗在領域內超越了沒有先驗的情況（無先驗基線的平均 h-AUROC：周期性時鐘 +14%，p<0.001；保守殘差在0.25標籤比例下 +47%），而有效的先驗在域外轉移時 (+53%)，替代了特徵轉移，而窗口已經恢復的先驗保持靜止，注意力偏差機制則未顯示出可測量的增益。KITE 是一種可切換的、可歸因的上下文條件化路徑，並且是一種向跨域、預訓練時間序列基礎世界模型擴展的基礎，這些模型明確地承載其治理結構。
